title: Step-up turns ratio
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) must be the correct numerical ratio (e.g., 1/40 or 0.025).

title: Step-down turns ratio
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) must be the correct numerical ratio (e.g., 90/1 or 90).

title: Transmission line current
description: Important: The solution must correctly calculate the transmission line current from the allowable power loss (P_loss = I²R).

title: Step-up transformer voltage
description: Important: The solution must correctly calculate the secondary (high) voltage of the step-up transformer using P = U₂I₂.

title: Voltage drop calculation
description: Important: The solution must correctly calculate the voltage drop across the transmission line and subtract it to find the input voltage at the step-down transformer.

title: Transformer ratio formula
description: Optional: The solution explicitly states the transformer voltage-turns ratio relationship (U₁/U₂ = n₁/n₂) for both transformers.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: The solution demonstrates consistent unit handling (e.g., kW to W, kV to V).

title: Power loss misinterpretation
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly using the generator output power P (200 kW) instead of the allowable loss (2 kW) to calculate the transmission line current.

title: Sign or arithmetic error
description: Pitfall: Making an arithmetic error in calculating voltages or ratios, or incorrectly adding the line drop instead of subtracting.
